# Conditional inference — frozen P0-F contract

Native expectations were frozen before production changes. The implementation
is under regression validation; full same-source acceptance is pending.
`FROZEN.json` retains the facts at its original freeze event.

`cases.json` preserves the original 24 discovery sources and adds 24 forms.
ES5/ES2022 × CommonJS/ESNext × strictFunctionTypes true/false yields 384 complete
observations. Strict null checking and the explicit ES5 library remain enabled.

`reference.json` records pinned TypeScript 5.9.3: 360 accepts, 24 rejects,
368 declaration files, 720 isolated authored positive/negative consumers,
368 selected-edition JavaScript parses and 48 executions. An independent Native
replay reproduced the complete reference byte for byte. The exact hash is
recorded in `FROZEN.json`.

`boundary-controls.json` contains twelve separate policy controls: six work
limits, two parser-depth limits, two ambient owners and two runtime-authority
refusals. `boundary-reference.json` retains their independent Native calibration:
ten valid type programs and two type-only names rejected as runtime values.
These controls have zero direct agreement credit.

The accepted P0-E compiler is retained as the pre-repair baseline. Its original
24-program discovery has eight complete agreements and sixteen differences;
the complete expanded matrix has 144 agreements and 240 differences, including
sixteen Native-rejected observations with incorrectly published BlueTSC output.
Keep every original program, expected diagnostic and declaration byte. The
expanded baseline and failed calibration attempts are retained separately.

`alias-controls.json` and `ALIAS_CONTROLS_FROZEN.json` contain a separate
24-observation regression supplement for unused scalar-alias parameters,
named record-alias arguments and identity aliases. These Native expectations
were frozen after the first primary repairs and before the alias regression
repair. The supplement is mandatory and adds zero inventory credit.

The permanent record adapter is verification-only: it compares a fresh Native
replay with the frozen reference and cannot regenerate that reference. The BlueTSC
adapter checks complete diagnostics, byte-exact declarations, isolated consumers,
selected-edition syntax and execution, then the separate alias supplement.

See the phase's `CONDITIONAL_INFERENCE_FOLLOWUP.md` for all completion gates.
